name: knife-workshop
description: Production-ready MVP for a handmade knife workshop catalog with public site, admin panel, API, worker and Docker Compose.

scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec api sh -lc "./node_modules/.bin/prisma migrate deploy"
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec api sh -lc "PATH=/app/node_modules/.bin:/app/apps/api/node_modules/.bin:$PATH ./node_modules/.bin/prisma db seed"
scripts.db:studio: docker compose exec api sh -lc "PATH=/app/node_modules/.bin:/app/apps/api/node_modules/.bin:$PATH ./node_modules/.bin/prisma studio --hostname 0.0.0.0"
